nodes.label: Launcher icon (xxxhdpi) — stock Android Studio template icon: white Android robot head (bugdroid, two antennae, two eyes) casting a diagonal drop shadow over a green grid background, rounded-square adaptive-icon frame. This is the unmodified default template asset, i.e. the base/minimaCore node app carries NO custom Minima branding at this density; the app's identity comes from its function (org.minimarex.minimacore background node), not visual branding.
Android robot mascot (bugdroid) — the head-with-antennae figure depicted in the icon, marking it as the default Android Studio project template artwork rather than Minima-specific branding.
